expectations.text: Says to screen creators on audience fit, views per video and engagement per view rather than subscriber count
expectations.evidence: The screen lists audience fit, "views per video, then comments and likes per view". It adds "Subscribers are also not viewers [YouTube]".

expectations.text: Says creator size by itself is not disqualifying
expectations.evidence: "His size is not the problem. PostHog's handbook says larger creators 'are often more efficient' [practitioner]."

expectations.text: Gives a concrete screening threshold or ratio and labels it as practitioner or a vendor's published practice
expectations.evidence: "One vendor's floor is 5,000 views per video, with 0.002-0.005 comments per view as 'good' [practitioner]."

expectations.text: Recommends the creator write the read in their own words from a short brief (2-3 points)
expectations.evidence: "Replace it with a brief of 2-3 true points. The creator writes the words."

expectations.text: Requires disclosure and ticking YouTube's paid promotion setting, written into the contract or brief
expectations.evidence: The timeline says "Write contracts with disclosure terms". The brief says "Disclosure: spoken, plus the paid-promotion box".

expectations.text: Recommends a tagged link in the top three lines of the description
expectations.evidence: "tagged link in the top three description lines".

expectations.text: Recommends asking viewers to name the creator at signup in addition to or instead of only a promo code
expectations.evidence: "creators ask viewers to name them at signup" and the "tell us you came from [creator] at signup" line.

expectations.text: Mentions YouTube's Collaborations feature or an integration in the creator's format as an option over a pre-roll
expectations.evidence: "Prefer a Collaboration or integration in the creator's own format over a pre-roll read."

expectations.text: Recommends finding creators via Studio's 'Channels your audience watches' or creators the team already watches
expectations.evidence: "Open Studio's 'Channels your audience watches'... If not, ask your engineers which YouTubers they watch."

expectations.text: Recommends comparing deals on cost per attributed signup or cost per thousand views
expectations.evidence: "Read results: cost per attributed signup and cost per thousand views per deal."

expectations.text: Recommends repeat deals with creators that work rather than one-off placements
expectations.evidence: "Wave 2: repeat the winners." and "A recurring collaboration beats a one-off [practitioner]."
